classicPunishmentsList: Let the group pick your lock screen wallpaper for the rest of the night
Send 'we need to talk' to the 3rd person in your recent texts and don't reply for 10 minutes
Let the player to your left post anything to your close friends story
Change your Instagram bio to whatever the group decides until tomorrow
Do your best TikTok dance with no music while everyone films
Let someone go through your Hinge/Tinder and send one message of their choice
Read your most recent Notes app entry out loud
Text your ex 'thinking about you' and screenshot the read receipt for the group
Let the group pick a song and you have to lip-sync the whole chorus like it's your Grammy moment
Rate every player's outfit out of 10, brutally honest
Hand your phone to the person across from you for 2 full rounds
FaceTime your mom and tell her you're 'making responsible choices tonight'
Speak only in TikTok sounds and quotes until your next turn
Let the group write a tweet-length caption and post it on your story
Do 15 squats while narrating them like a fitness influencer
Scroll your camera roll on the big screen (or pass the phone) for 20 seconds, no skipping
Reply to the last Instagram DM you ignored, right now, out loud
Give a 30-second TED Talk on why you're the main character
Wear your shirt inside out until someone else taps out
Let the group give you a new nickname; everyone uses it for the rest of the night
Send a voice note to your group chat saying 'guys I think I'm in love' and nothing else
Show the group your screen time report, highest app first
Do your best impression of each player, they decide if it was accurate
Like the oldest photo on your ex's Instagram
Let the player to your right change your contact name for them to anything
Freestyle rap about the person across from you for 20 seconds
Hold a plank until the next player finishes their card
Say 'periodt' after every sentence until your next turn
Show the group your most recent Google search
Let the group choose your Spotify song and you have to play it at full volume on your phone
Pretend to be a flight attendant and do the safety demo for the group
Text your crush exactly what the group writes, no edits
Read your last 3 sent texts out loud, in your dramatic reading voice
Put on an accent and order a fake Uber Eats out loud until your next turn
Let someone draw on your arm with a pen; it stays until you shower
Share your location with the group chat for 24 hours
Do a runway walk to the kitchen and back with full attitude
Let the group record a 10-second video of you and post it to your story
Admit to one thing you've lied about in this game so far
Show the group the last meme you saved
Do the 'Say So' dance from memory; the group grades you
Call the 5th contact in your phone and sing them happy birthday
Stand on one leg for your entire next turn
Let the group pick a filter and you take a selfie with it as your new profile pic for 24 hours
Tell the group your most embarrassing Spotify Wrapped artist
Speak in third person until your next turn
Let someone else reply to your next 3 texts for you
Give the person to your left a sincere compliment with direct eye contact for 10 seconds
Scream 'I love you' at the next person who walks into the room
Show the group your Hinge prompts and let them roast one
Act out your last breakup as a one-person play in 20 seconds
Tell the group the real reason you were late to the last thing you were late to
Eat a spoonful of a condiment chosen by the group
Let the group read your 'Hidden' photo album titles out loud (not the photos)
Say the alphabet backwards; mess up and start again, max 3 tries
Do a dramatic slow-motion fall every time someone says your name until your next turn
Text the group chat 'who's awake' and send a selfie, no caption
Let the group pick your Instagram story music for the next 3 posts
Describe your type using only emojis in the group chat
Show the group your most-used emoji and explain yourself
Let the group DM one celebrity from your account
Hold eye contact with the person across from you until one of you laughs; you drink if you lose
Give a weather report about the vibes in the room, news anchor style
Delete one app of the group's choice for the rest of the night
Wear sunglasses indoors until the next punishment is given
Do your skincare routine as an ASMR video with narration
Confess your most recent 'I'm never drinking again' moment
Let the group give you a fake accent and a backstory; stay in character for 2 rounds
Say something nice about your ex, sincerely
Show the group your most recent Venmo/Cash App transaction and explain it
Re-enact your most awkward DM you ever sent, word for word
Twerk for 10 seconds or do 20 jumping jacks, group's choice
Let the group text your sibling anything 'reasonable'
Stand up and give a toast to everyone in the room, one line each
Switch phones with the person to your right for one round
Repeat every sentence you say twice until your next turn
Do your best 'get ready with me' intro and film it
Reveal the last person you stalked on Instagram
Let the group decide your drink for the rest of the night
Draw a mustache on yourself with eyeliner; it stays for 2 rounds
Narrate everything you do like a nature documentary until your next turn
Put a spoon in your mouth and keep it there until your next turn
Let the player to your left take a photo of you that you can't delete tonight
Tell the group your most unhinged late-night thought this week
Sing your next three sentences instead of speaking them
Admit how many unread emails you have, then show proof
Give your phone to the group and let them pick who you follow next
Do a 30-second stand-up set about the host
Post a 'rate my fit' poll to your story with what you're wearing right now
Act like a bouncer and check everyone's ID before they can speak for one round

shotOClockCards.text: Shot O'Clock: Everyone takes a shot and says one word to describe tonight.
Shot O'Clock: Whoever posted a story most recently takes two.
Shot O'Clock: Shots for anyone who's checked their phone in the last 5 minutes.
Shot O'Clock: Everyone takes a shot for the group chat that never plans anything.
Shot O'Clock: Take a shot with the person you've known the longest here.
Shot O'Clock: Everyone with a situationship takes one. Everyone else takes one for them.
Shot O'Clock: Take a shot to your Spotify Wrapped top artist. Say the name out loud first.
Shot O'Clock: Last person to touch their phone takes a shot. Go.
Shot O'Clock: Everyone takes a shot and whoever makes the worst face takes another.
Shot O'Clock: Shot for everyone who ghosted someone this year.
Shot O'Clock: Everyone takes a shot with their eyes closed, no hands.
Shot O'Clock: The host picks a shot buddy. Those two take two.
Shot O'Clock: Everyone takes a shot for the friend who cancelled tonight.
Shot O'Clock: Cheers to the person who looks the best tonight, group vote, then everyone drinks.
Shot O'Clock: Take a shot and immediately send a selfie to your group chat.
Shot O'Clock: Everyone who's single takes one. Everyone who's taken takes one for being boring.
Shot O'Clock: Shot for everyone whose screen time is over 6 hours. Show proof.
Shot O'Clock: Take a shot and do a 3-second pose for a group photo.
Shot O'Clock: Everyone takes a shot for the song that's about to be stuck in your head. Host picks it.
Shot O'Clock: Youngest player calls the shot. Everyone does what they say.
Shot O'Clock: Take a shot for every ex you still follow (max 3, we're not monsters).
Shot O'Clock: Everyone takes a shot and says their most-used emoji.
Shot O'Clock: Shot for anyone who's ever soft-launched a relationship.
Shot O'Clock: Everyone takes a shot while the host counts down from 3 in a dramatic accent.
Shot O'Clock: Take a shot with whoever is sitting furthest from you.
Shot O'Clock: Everyone takes a shot for the DM they never answered.
Shot O'Clock: Everyone takes a shot and then everyone screams the host's name.

wildCardsList.text: Main Character: You're immune to the next punishment aimed at you.
Group Chat Rule: Anyone who says 'literally' for the next 3 rounds drinks.
Switch Up: Everyone passes their drink one seat to the left.
Plus One: Pick a player; they do your next dare with you.
Ick Check: Everyone names an ick. The most-agreed-with ick's owner drinks.
Soft Launch: Everyone posts a mysterious story right now. Last to post drinks.
Silent Round: No talking for one full round. First to speak drinks.
Villain Era: You assign the next two dares to anyone you want.
Rizz Check: Everyone delivers their best pickup line to the host. Worst one drinks.
Take a shot if you've texted 'wyd' after midnight this month.
Take a shot if you've ever cried to a Taylor Swift song.
Take a shot if you've bought something because of a TikTok.
Take a shot if you're in a situationship right now.
Take a shot if you've ever stalked someone's ex on Instagram.
Take a shot if your screen time went up this week.
Take a shot if you've left someone on delivered on purpose.
Take a shot if you've pretended to be busy to skip plans.
Take a shot if you have more than 3 dating apps installed.
Take a shot if you've ever faked a bad signal to end a call.
Take a shot if you've posted a thirst trap and deleted it within an hour.
Take a shot if your Uber rating is under 4.8.
Take a shot if you've ever replied 'haha' to something that wasn't funny.
Take a shot if you know your ex's new partner's name.
Take a shot if you've ever ghosted and then come back like nothing happened.
Take a shot if you've ever sent a risky text and then turned your phone face down.
Everyone Drinks: If anyone in the room has a BeReal notification unopened right now.
Categories: Host names a category (e.g. Netflix shows). Go around; first to blank drinks.
Never Have I Ever: Three fingers. Host starts. Last with fingers up gives out a dare.
Most Likely To: Host reads a trait; everyone points. Most pointed-at drinks.
Camera Roll Roulette: Scroll with eyes closed, stop, show the group. Or drink twice.
Phone Stack: Everyone's phone in the middle for 2 rounds. First to grab theirs drinks.
Buddy System: Pick a player. For 3 rounds, when one of you drinks, both drink.
Reverse: Play order flips. The last player to notice drinks.
Skip: Hand this card to anyone; they take your next turn.
Double or Nothing: Do your next dare for immunity, or sit it out and drink twice.
Story Time: Everyone shares their worst date in one sentence. Group picks the winner; everyone else drinks.
Accent Round: Everyone talks in an accent until the next wildcard. Breakers drink.
Compliment Chain: Compliment the person to your left, go around. Anyone who laughs drinks.
Lie Detector: Say two truths and a lie. If the group guesses the lie, you drink.
Snack Tax: Whoever eats next has to share a secret.
DJ Swap: Whoever controls the music gives it to the person who's drunk the least.
Name Drop: Anyone who says someone's name who isn't here drinks, for 2 rounds.
Thumb Master: You're thumb master until the next wildcard. Thumb on table, last to copy drinks.
Question Master: Anyone who answers your questions for the next 2 rounds drinks.
Little Green Man: Everyone has an invisible man on their cup. Forget to lift him off before drinking, drink again.
Waterfall: Start drinking; the player to your left can't stop until you do, and so on.
Spotify Reveal: Everyone shows their most recently played song. Worst one, group vote, drinks.
Screenshot Roulette: Show the most recent screenshot on your phone or drink twice.
Delulu Check: Everyone shares a delusion they're holding onto. Most delulu drinks.
Red Flag Round: Everyone admits a red flag. The group votes the biggest; they drink.
Green Flag Round: Say a green flag about the person across from you or drink.
Energy Check: Everyone rates their current vibe 1–10. Lowest drinks, highest gives a dare.
Timer: Everyone finishes their drink before the next card is read. Last one does a dare.
Confession Booth: One anonymous confession typed into the host's phone and read aloud.
Swap Seats: Everyone moves one seat clockwise. Whoever ends up next to their ex (or crush) drinks.
Hot Seat: The group asks you 3 rapid-fire questions. Dodge one, drink one.
Group Selfie: Everyone in frame in 10 seconds. Anyone missing drinks.
Finish the Lyric: Host plays a song and pauses it. First to finish the line gives out two sips.
Opposites: Say the opposite of what you mean for one round. Slip-ups drink.
Vibe Shift: Host changes the music genre. Anyone who complains drinks.
Alphabet Drinks: Go around naming celebrities A to Z. Blank or repeat, drink.
Date Night: Pick two players to go on a 20-second pretend date in front of everyone.
Trade: Swap your drink with anyone's. They can't refuse.
Ghost Protocol: Anyone who checks their phone in the next round drinks twice.
Wrapped: Everyone names their top artist. Anyone who shares one with someone else drinks together.
Group Dare: The whole room does the next dare together.
Pass the Ick: Say an ick; the person to your left must say a worse one, and so on. First to blank drinks.
Host's Choice: The host makes a rule that lasts until the next wildcard.
Bless Up: Give your drink to the person who's had the roughest week. They drink; you're safe.
Chaos: Everyone drinks, no reason.
Take a shot if you've ever been the reason the group chat went silent.
Take a shot if you follow more than 5 people you've never met.
Take a shot if you've cried in an Uber.
Take a shot if you've ever posted and immediately checked who viewed it.
Take a shot if you've ever deleted a text before they saw it.
Take a shot if your camera roll has more screenshots than photos.
Take a shot if you've matched with someone you already knew.
Take a shot if you've ever muted a close friend's story.
Take a shot if you know what your rising sign is.
Take a shot if you've ever said 'I'm leaving in 5' and stayed another hour.
Take a shot if you've ever rewatched your own story more than twice.
